name: Piper
description: Piper is a fast, local neural text to speech system that sounds great and is optimized for the Raspberry Pi 4. This container provides a Wyoming protocol server for Piper.
short_desc: Piper is a fast, local neural text to speech system that sounds great and is optimized for the Raspberry Pi 4
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: PIPER_VOICE
form_fields.hint: The Piper voice to use, in the format <language>-<name>-<quality>

form_fields.label: LOCAL_ONLY
form_fields.hint: If set to true, or any other value, the container will not attempt to download models from HuggingFace and will only use locally-provided models.

form_fields.label: PIPER_LENGTH
form_fields.hint: Voice speaking rate, 1.0 is default with < 1.0 being faster and > 1.0 being slower.

form_fields.label: PIPER_NOISE
form_fields.hint: Controls the variability of the voice by adding noise. Values above 1 will start to degrade audio.

form_fields.label: PIPER_NOISEW
form_fields.hint: Controls the variability of speaking cadence. Values above 1 produce extreme stutters and pauses.

form_fields.label: PIPER_SPEAKER
form_fields.hint: Speaker number to use if the voice supports multiple speakers.

form_fields.label: NO_STREAMING
form_fields.hint: Setting to true, or any other value, will disable support for streaming audio on sentence boundaries.
